main.description: A job posting, in the poster's repo. Salary transparency is required: a posting must state a salary range. The PDS stores any record, so the AppView enforces the rules this schema cannot express (a positive minimum, minimum ≤ maximum, maximum at most 2 × minimum, an ISO 4217 currency, a known period) and never shows a posting that breaks them. Postings can be edited (putRecord on the same key); every version is re-validated.

organization.description: Who is hiring, as the poster states it. Not verified.

applyUrl.description: Where to apply: an http(s) or mailto: link.

closeDate.description: Last day to apply, as YYYY-MM-DD. The posting leaves the board once that date has ended everywhere on Earth (UTC−12). Absent means open until deleted.

salary.description: The pay range, in whole units of the currency (85000 means 85,000; there are no minor units, and the data model has no floats).

max.description: At least min, and at most 2 × min.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code, upper case, e.g. USD, EUR, JPY.
